items.title_zh: 日本又要出手？日央行被曝汇率摸底，日元收窄跌幅
items.summary: The Bank of Japan is said to have conducted a rate check, the yen eased its intraday decline and market attention on another round of currency intervention by the Japanese authorities is rising.
items.summary_zh: 日本央行据称已进行汇率摸底，日元盘中跌势缓和，市场对日本当局再度干预汇市的关注升温

items.title: Auto industry urges Trump to bar Chinese automakers in U.S. ahead of Xi visit
items.title_zh: 汽车行业敦促特朗普在习近平到访前禁止中国车企进入美国
items.summary: Leaders of six major auto trade groups joined to sign a letter to the president.
items.summary_zh: 六大汽车行业组织的负责人联名致信总统。

items.title: Anthropic and OpenAI need truly independent safety evaluators, experts say in public letter
items.title_zh: 专家公开信：Anthropic 与 OpenAI 需要真正独立的安全评估方
items.summary: A coalition of over 100 AI experts are urging independence and transparency from Anthropic, OpenAI and other foundation model labs to conduct evaluations.
items.summary_zh: 由 100 多位 AI 专家组成的联盟呼吁 Anthropic、OpenAI 及其他基础模型实验室在评估中保持独立与透明。

items.title: Tokenization is set to change stock trading. These stocks could get a boost
items.title_zh: 代币化将改变股票交易，这些股票可能受益
items.summary: Digital exchanges are rocketing upward in Friday morning trading after regulatory changes that follow the failure of the Clarity Act in Congress.
items.summary_zh: 在《清晰法案》未能在国会通过后出台的监管变化推动下，数字交易所股在周五早盘大幅上涨。

items.title: AI safety debate meets reality at Dreamforce as business leaders say last year's models are enough
items.title_zh: Dreamforce 上 AI 安全辩论遭遇现实：企业领袖称去年的模型已经够用
items.summary: At Salesforce's annual mega-conference in San Francisco, attendees said they get enough value from older AI models.
items.summary_zh: 在旧金山举行的 Salesforce 年度大会上，与会者表示他们从较旧的 AI 模型已能获得足够价值。

items.title: US manufacturing recovery suddenly hits the brakes: August output unexpectedly fell 0.3%, capacity utilisation at a five-month low
items.title_zh: 美国制造业复苏突然“踩刹车”：8月产值意外下降0.3%，产能利用率降至五个月低点
items.summary: Hit by cooling business equipment production and higher input costs for manufacturers, US factory output unexpectedly declined for the first time this year.
items.summary_zh: 受企业设备生产降温以及制造业企业面临更高投入成本的影响，美国工厂产值今年以来首次意外下降

items.title: European diesel retail prices top $300 as Macron moves to convene the G7 on coordinated strategic reserve releases
items.title_zh: 欧洲柴油零售价突破300美元，马克龙要召集G7谈协同释放战略油储
items.summary: No longer content with unilateral responses to surging energy prices, French President Emmanuel Macron announced he will convene a Group of Seven meeting within weeks to discuss the possible release of strategic petroleum product reserves.
items.summary_zh: 法国总统马克龙不再满足于单边应对能源价格飙升，宣布将在数周内召集七国集团（G7）会议，讨论释放战略石油产品储备的可能性
